note: NIST National Vulnerability Database: every published CVE, its description, and NVD's assessment.
title: NIST National Vulnerability Database (CVE API 2.0)
description: Two events per CVE. CYB.VULN.PUBLISHED is the publication, with the English description as text, known when it was published. CYB.VULN.NVD_ASSESSMENT is the state of NVD's analysis (status, CVSS scores, weaknesses, affected product) as of its last modification, known from that time, so scores assigned later never leak into a rewind.

sources.license: US government work; public (NVD terms of use)
sources.known_at_rule: Publication time for the publication; last-modified time for the assessment.
